resources.string: Replaces your credential; every critical item is destroyed
Your vault PIN and your current credential password confirm it is you; the new password protects the new credential.

A new credential replaces the current one. Every critical item in it is destroyed for good, on every device; nobody, VettID included, can bring them back. Your other items, connections and messages stay.
I understand that every critical item is destroyed.
Use the new password from now on. Your daily check starts again from now.
Your vault hasn\'t answered yet, so VettID is checking whether your new credential was made. Keep your new password at hand.
VettID can\'t reach your vault right now, so it doesn\'t know yet whether your new credential was made. It will check as soon as it can. Keep both your old and your new password at hand.
VettID couldn\'t confirm whether your new credential was made, because something else changed in your vault at the same time. Either your previous or your new password may be the current one.
Your new credential wasn\'t made. Your credential, its password and your critical items are unchanged.
